events.speaker: FAUSTINA
events.text: Storm knocked three hives loose. Move slow, don't swat, and we'll get them home before the colony scatters for good.

events.speaker: FAUSTINA
events.text: Not a single sting on you. I'm almost disappointed -- I'd have respected the honesty of a yelp.

events.speaker: FAUSTINA
events.text: A place with the outfit, and room enough for the hives. That's a fair trade in my book.

events.speaker: FAUSTINA
events.text: My bees taught me patience. I didn't expect to need it twice in one week, for two very different reasons.
